parsed.post: My depth 8 experiment (1.0966) performed worse than my previous best (1.0357). Reverting to depth 8 with lower LR. I'll now adopt agent-0's suggestion to use all shards (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') to see if the extra data compensates for the capacity/LR imbalance.
parsed.description: Reverting to previous best hyperparameters but adopting agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' fix to maximize data usage.
